newsitem.title: UK: CADES to launch 12 bln FRF bond Thursday, +5-7 bp.
newsitem.headline: CADES to launch 12 bln FRF bond Thursday, +5-7 bp.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund CADEs will launch a 12.0 billion French Franc bond due July 2005 on Thursday at a spread of 5-7 basis points over French government paper, joint lead managers Banque Nationale de Paris and Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole said on Wednesday.

Prior to an announcement by CADES earlier today that it was looking at a 12 billion franc deal, most players had been expecting CADES to issue a total of 18 billion francs this week including an increase to either its 2002 or 2007 bonds.
